QuestInfo.name: Neinheart's Thanks
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# thanks you for protecting the tears of the Divine Bird and wants to give you a reward for it. You'd better head over to #b#m130000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p1101002# told you that you and he will have a chance to fight...and gave you a meaningful smile.

0.0: Hello, Aran. I see that you are bit busy right now, but please, allow me to speak.
0.1: Thanks to you, the Seal Stone protected by #m130000000#, #bthe one they call Shinsoo's Teardrop, was protected#k. You have my deepest thanks. If you could come meet me in #m130000000#, I'll have a gift waiting for you!\r\n#b(When you accept, you will move to Ereve.)#k

no.0: For you to reject the offer... I see that you're more modest than I thought. Please also know that too much modesty will actually make you look foolish. Please reconsider.

1.0: Ah, you're here. Honestly, at first, I didn't believe you at all. I sensed you had a very different aura, and the contents of the letter seemed way too real. That's why I had my suspicions about you.
1.1: But after a thorough background search, I realized that those worries were unfounded. Even that offensive aura of yours...#bI can understand, based on your very dynamic past#k... Ah, don't mind me. I was just thinking out loud. Here's the reward for your work.

yes.0: I know this doesn't seem much, but I am sure it'll help you on your journey. Do not feel pressured by this or anything. #bWe may end up joining forces someday you know#k... That was me thinking out loud again. We'll meet again someday. Goodbye for now.
